name: service
description: The service domain pack (E12, docs/decisions/011): ordinary request-driven services, the concrete test of the pipeline-core/domain-pack split E13 extracted. Landed in phases, not one epic-sized change: phase 1 (docs/decisions/016) proved the three lenses reused UNCHANGED from genai (tracing, ops, pii-governance) run against real service-domain points with zero SKILL.md edits; phase 2 (docs/decisions/017) added the anti-redundancy gate; phase 3 (docs/decisions/018) added the first S1 registry (Express, http_server_route), docs-grounded rather than corpus-verified (no real TS/Express corpus repo has been run through this adapter yet -- named explicitly, same honesty precedent as the genai pack's own livekit registry). telemetry-cost (adapted, not reused), slo and dependency (new) all need genuine new skill content -- burn-rate derivation, error-budget policy, dependency-criticality rules -- and remain explicit follow-up work. db_query/queue_producer/queue_consumer/scheduled_job S1 detection also remain declared_undetected -- each needs its own per-library research this phase did not attempt. declarative_route and http_client_call are E11-TS's TypeScript adapter's own fixed passes (SP12, docs/decisions/013), previously undetected by any loaded pack (docs/decisions/014's own named gap) -- declaring them here is what makes those already-detected points visible to S3's gap model for the first time.

registries.confidence_note: Docs-grounded (Express's own public API, https://expressjs.com/en/4x/api.html), NOT corpus-verified -- no real Express repo has been run through this adapter yet, unlike every genai registry entry, which either has real corpus evidence (anthropic, 100% recall) or says so explicitly when it doesn't (livekit). Deliberately narrow: only `const app = express()` (a bare factory call assigned to a variable, the module_function_call detector shape -- oah/discovery/typescript_adapter.py's ImportResolver.resolve_factory_call, newly implemented alongside this entry, since the shape existed in schemas/domain_pack.schema.json but no adapter actually implemented it before this). Two real, deliberate exclusions from method_suffixes, not oversights: `app.all(...)`/`app.use(...)` are left out -- `use` is overwhelmingly called for plain middleware with no path argument at all (`app.use(cors())`) in real Express code, which this suffix-match alone can't distinguish from a genuine path-mounted sub-router, and including it would trade real false positives for marginal recall; `express.Router()` sub-router creation (a namespaced factory call, not a bare one) is also not covered -- a real, separate, NOT-yet-implemented receiver-creation shape. `get` is Express's own documented dual-purpose method (`app.get(name)` reads a setting; `app.get(path, ...handlers)` registers a route) -- the adapter requires 2+ call arguments before treating any of these five suffixes as a route registration, specifically to rule out the single-argument settings-getter form.

covered_signals.caveat: Only when the framework's own router exposes a low-cardinality template to the instrumentation library -- a raw/untemplated path (e.g. AEM resolving a URL to a content path by resource type) is not covered and needs the pack's own cardinality_guard design, not this baseline.
Conditionally required ("if request has ended with an error") on the HTTP duration histograms, per docs/decisions/012 finding 6 -- not present on every data point, only error ones.
